import hashlib,importlib,importlib.metadata,json,platform,subprocess,sys,sysconfig
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); source=root/'.deps/g6k_hybrid'; runtime=json.loads((root/'.deps/runtime.json').read_text())
modules={name:importlib.import_module(name) for name in ['fpylll','g6k','g6k.siever','g6k.slicer','numpy','Cython','cysignals']}
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=source,text=True).strip()
assert head=='bd72687b2ebbaff16fb692259f83b327bbcd9586'
assert all(Path(modules[name].__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source) for name in ['g6k','g6k.siever','g6k.slicer'])
patch=(root/'provenance/upstream_source.patch').read_bytes()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','kernel/hash_table.inl'],cwd=source)==patch
files=['README.rst','setup.py','configure.ac','hybrid_attack.py','run_prog_hyb.py','tailBDD.py','g6k/slicer.pyx','kernel/slicer.cpp','kernel/hash_table.inl','utils.py','LICENSE']
result={'python':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'prefix':sys.prefix,'base_prefix':sys.base_prefix,'platform':platform.platform(),'compiler':sysconfig.get_config_var('CC'),'compiler_version':subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/g++','--version'],text=True).strip(),'upstream_commit':head,'upstream_url':'https://github.com/ElenaKirshanova/g6k_hybrid.git','runtime':runtime,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),'modules':{name:mod.__file__ for name,mod in modules.items()},'versions':{name:importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ['fpylll','numpy','Cython','cysignals','pytest','setuptools']},'source_files_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256((source/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files},'extension_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256(Path(modules[name].__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['g6k.siever','g6k.slicer']},'max_sieving_dimension':64,'isolation':'Separate experiment venv and rebuilt local G6K; read-only shared base dependency packages, not a hermetic dependency snapshot.'}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
